title: Dynamic version and console entry point lack a linked packaging smoke test
reasoning: The distribution relies on dynamic version discovery and a console-script import target, but this feature includes no tests. Source-level tests can pass while wheel construction, metadata resolution, installation, or command import fails, making this a release regression risk.
recommendation: Add a clean-environment test that builds the wheel, installs it without dependencies, validates its metadata/version, and runs `clawpatch-supervise --version`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are linked to the feature, and the included excerpts show no build-and-install verification.
suggestedRegressionTest: Build a wheel with `python -m build`, install it into a fresh virtual environment using `--no-deps`, then assert that package metadata resolves and `clawpatch-supervise --version` exits successfully.
minimumFixScope: Add one packaging smoke test covering wheel build, installation, dynamic version resolution, and the declared console entry point.
